spec: TRACK 7 — Git/CI history integrity & cross-file version-state divergence. Files: .github/workflows/*.yml (3 workflows: stamp-last-commit, update-search-index, verify), sync.ps1, dev-logs/PortfolioWebsite_TRACKER.md (422 lines, v1-v46), assets/js/last-commit.json, graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md's 'Graph Freshness' block. Review the 3 GitHub Actions workflows for race conditions between the commit-back bot and a human's next local pull.
